items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: This is Ronald Reagan, inviting you to enjoy

ctx.x: I want a steady water, body my time. Next Sunday night, Ingrid Bergman, Yves Montand, and Tony Perkins. Headline R show in a movie scene from Anatole Litbox, Goodbye Again, which should be a tremendous hit. A love story in which Ingrid Bergman loves Parisian playboy Yves Montand, and is comforted by the youthful Tony Perkins when Montand becomes indifferent. It's distinguished not only by their performances, but by the skillful direction of Anatole Litbox against the colorful backgrounds of Paris. Now, in…
